hook.name: LineaDATHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the LineaDAT ecosystem on Linea that applies a time-decaying buy fee (99% → 10% over 89 minutes) collected via afterSwapReturnsDelta, then distributes fees 80/10/10 among the strategy treasury, LineaDAT token burn (or creator on the self-launch), and the creator. Pool initialization and liquidity additions are restricted to the factory, and all trading is blocked until a configurable scheduled launch time.
